brief: Holds rhythm written as a string, Tidal's mini-notation, as a function of time that answers the events of any cycle.
detail: A pattern is not a list of notes but a function from a cycle number to the events in that cycle, so the verbs compose. In the string a b c is a sequence sharing the cycle, ~ a rest, [a b] a group sharing one step, [a, b] a stack, <a b> an alternation by cycle, a*2 twice as fast, a/2 half as fast, a? sometimes, a!3 three times and a@3 three steps long. A word is a note name or a stroke, with bd, sn and hh stored as kick, snare and hihat. ToScoreQ turns cycles into a stzSoundScore, four beats a cycle, which is data a player can render; nothing here opens an audio device or plays. Not here: euclidean rhythms, fractional factors, sample banks and jux. The output has not been heard by a person (UNPERCEIVED): it is checked by the events it holds.
